'''Dac pirate droids''' were a type of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] that were employed by [[Darth Luft]] and his [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] in [[139 ABY]]. They were deployed from starships and were used to disable the electronic operating systems of other starships. They saw action during the [[Liberation of Mon Calamari Shipyards|liberation]] of the [[Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards]] at [[Dac/Legends|Dac]].
